name: Hoppscotch Desktop
description: Tauri updater with pinned minisign pubkey; per-artifact sigs verified live.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Hoppscotch Desktop configures a Tauri updater key and desktop release endpoint and uses the updater plugin for checks. Live per-artifact signatures and shipped dependency enforcement have not been verified.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; Tauri updater internals, release metadata, artifact signatures, and platform packaging were not independently audited.

original_evidence.text: | Hoppscotch Desktop (Tauri) | github.com/hoppscotch/hoppscotch — `packages/hoppscotch-desktop` | Y (`tauri-plugin-updater` 2.3.1) | Check: Y automatic on app launch (`onMounted` → `checkForUpdates()`) unless user has set `disableUpdateChecks`. Download+Install: N automatic — UI shows an "Install Update" button (`UpdateFlow.vue`) the user must click, then a separate "Restart Now" button. | Y — `download_and_install_update` Tauri command downloads then installs; `restart_application` relaunches | HTTPS — updater endpoint `https://releases.hoppscotch.com/hoppscotch-selfhost-desktop.json` (verified live 2026-08-20, returns valid JSON); artifacts hosted at `github.com/hoppscotch/releases` releases | Y — each platform entry in the fetched JSON carries its own detached signature ("`signature from tauri secret key`", minisign format), verified confirmed live: e.g. `windows-x86_64.signature` present alongside its `.msi`/`.AppImage` URL | signature [minisign / Ed25519, via `tauri-plugin-updater`'s built-in verification] | pubkey pinned in `tauri.conf.json`, baked into the app binary at build time (`RWRYQfDU+OSdYG5D34gfcLq6tnvCvec87euieOJhCOY0Lws0cHVkYkx7` decoded from the base64 minisign key block) | packages/hoppscotch-desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json:33-40 (`"updater": {"active": true, "endpoints": ["https://releases.hoppscotch.com/hoppscotch-selfhost-desktop.json"], "dialog": true, "pubkey": "dW50cnVzdGVkIGNvbW1lbnQ6IG1pbmlzaWduIHB1YmxpYyBrZXk6IDYwOURFNEY4RDRGMDQxNTgK..."}`); src-tauri/Cargo.toml (`tauri-plugin-updater = "2.3.1"`); src-tauri/src/updater.rs (`check_for_updates`, `download_and_install_update` commands); src/views/StandardHome.vue:150-165 (`onMounted` auto-check gated by `settings.disableUpdateChecks`); src/views/shared/UpdateFlow.vue (`Install Update` / `Restart Now` buttons — user-gated) | Solid implementation: pinned public key + per-artifact signatures + HTTPS, and destructive actions (download/install) require explicit user click. |
